chemistry-h1-q1.title: Chii chiri mhedziso chaiyo
chemistry-h1-q1.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h1-q1.material: Chii chiri mhedziso chaiyo kwazvo yebvunzo inenzanisa kutakura magetsi kwechinhu A (sodium chloride) nechinhu B (shuga)?
chemistry-h1-q1.s.s1.prompt: Chii chiri mhedziso chaiyo kwazvo yebvunzo inenzanisa kutakura magetsi kwechinhu A (sodium chloride) nechinhu B (shuga)?
chemistry-h1-q1.s.s1.explain: Sodium chloride, chinhu chine ionic bond, chinonyungudika mumvura ichiparadzaniswa kuita cations neanions, saka aqueous solution yayo inotakura magetsi. Shuga, chinhu chine covalent bond, chinonyungudika semamolecule uye hachina zvinotakura charge, saka hachitakure magetsi.

chemistry-h1-q1.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

chemistry-h1-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h1-q2.material: Kana sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution ichiwedzerwa zvishoma nezvishoma kuhydrochloric acid (HCl) yakasanganiswa yehuwandu hwakatarwa, ndeipi mhedziso chaiyo yekuyera shanduko yenhamba yemaion mu solution netembiricha?

chemistry-h1-q3.material: Ndeipi tsananguro chaiyo ye 'oxidation' ne 'reduction' mukemisitiri yemazuva ano, zvichibva pakuendeswa kwema electron?

chemistry-h1-q4.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h1-q4.material: Ndiko kudii kuchengetedza kunonzi 'cathodic protection (sacrificial anode method)', umo zvimedu zve zinc (Zn) kana magnesium (Mg) zvinobatanidzwa kumabhiriji kana zvikepe zvakagadzirwa nesimbi (Fe) kuti zvirege ku rust?
chemistry-h1-q4.s.s1.prompt: Ndiko kudii kuchengetedza kunonzi 'cathodic protection (sacrificial anode method)', umo zvimedu zve zinc (Zn) kana magnesium (Mg) zvinobatanidzwa kumabhiriji kana zvikepe zvakagadzirwa nesimbi (Fe) kuti zvirege ku rust?

chemistry-h1-c.title: [Kuvakwa kwemolecule epamusoro] Pakati
chemistry-h1-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h1-c.material: [Kuvakwa kwemolecule epamusoro] Pakati pemamolecule anoumbwa nema nonmetal elements ega 2 anozadzisa octet rule (ma electron 8 eparutivi rwekunze), ndeipi sarudzo inoronga nemazvo nhamba yemapeya ema electron akagoverwa (bonding) neasina kugoverwa (lone) emethane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃), nemvura (H₂O)?
chemistry-h1-c.s.s1.prompt: [Kuvakwa kwemolecule epamusoro] Pakati pemamolecule anoumbwa nema nonmetal elements ega 2 anozadzisa octet rule (ma electron 8 eparutivi rwekunze), ndeipi sarudzo inoronga nemazvo nhamba yemapeya ema electron akagoverwa (bonding) neasina kugoverwa (lone) emethane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃), nemvura (H₂O)?
chemistry-h1-c.s.s1.explain: Methane ($\text{CH}_4$) ine mapeya akagoverwa $4$ uye ma lone pair $0$. Ammonia ($\text{NH}_3$), nekuda kwemaitiro enitrojeni, ine mapeya akagoverwa $3$ uye lone pair $1$, uye mvura ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$) ine mapeya akagoverwa $2$ uye ma lone pair $2$.

chemistry-h1-q5.material: Ndeupi dambudziko renharaunda rinokonzerwa kana sulfur dioxide (SO₂) kana nitrogen oxides (NOx) zvinoburitswa nekupiswa kwemafuta ekare zvichipindura nemhute yemvura mumhepo kuita sulfuric acid kana nitric acid, zvichidzikisa pH yemvura inonaya pasi pehuwandu hwakajairika (inenge 5.6)?

chemistry-killer-10.title: Funga equilibrium yekugadzira ammonia
chemistry-killer-10.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-10.material:
Funga equilibrium yekugadzira ammonia $\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$, $\Delta H < 0$ (exothermic). Kutanga paequilibrium mu vessel yakavharwa pakupisa kwakagadzikana, shanduko dzinotevera dzega dzega dzinoitwa dzega uye equilibrium itsva inosvikwa.
(A) Uchichengeta tembiricha yakagadzikana, vhoriyamu yevessel inodzikiswa.
(B) Uchichengeta vhoriyamu yakagadzikana, tembiricha inokwidziridzwa.
(C) Uchichengeta tembiricha nevhoriyamu zvakagadzikana, Ar(g) isingapindure inowedzerwa.
(D) Uchichengeta tembiricha ne total pressure zvakagadzikana, Ar(g) inowedzerwa kuti vhoriyamu iwedzere.
(E) Uchichengeta tembiricha nevhoriyamu zvakagadzikana, $\mathrm{H_2(g)}$ inowedzerwa.
Sarudza nyaya dzose umo huwandu (mol) ye $\mathrm{NH_3}$ paequilibrium itsva hukuru kupfuura paequilibrium yekutanga.
chemistry-killer-10.s.s1.prompt:
Funga equilibrium yekugadzira ammonia $\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$, $\Delta H < 0$ (exothermic). Kutanga paequilibrium mu vessel yakavharwa pakupisa kwakagadzikana, shanduko dzinotevera dzega dzega dzinoitwa dzega uye equilibrium itsva inosvikwa.
(A) Uchichengeta tembiricha yakagadzikana, vhoriyamu yevessel inodzikiswa.
(B) Uchichengeta vhoriyamu yakagadzikana, tembiricha inokwidziridzwa.
(C) Uchichengeta tembiricha nevhoriyamu zvakagadzikana, Ar(g) isingapindure inowedzerwa.
(D) Uchichengeta tembiricha ne total pressure zvakagadzikana, Ar(g) inowedzerwa kuti vhoriyamu iwedzere.
(E) Uchichengeta tembiricha nevhoriyamu zvakagadzikana, $\mathrm{H_2(g)}$ inowedzerwa.
Sarudza nyaya dzose umo huwandu (mol) ye $\mathrm{NH_3}$ paequilibrium itsva hukuru kupfuura paequilibrium yekutanga.
chemistry-killer-10.s.s1.explain:
Nhanho 1: Mamole egasi anobva pa 4 (zvinopindura) kusvika pa 2 (chigadzirwa). Forward reaction i exothermic.
Nhanho 2: (A) Kudzikisa vhoriyamu kunokwidziridza pressure, saka equilibrium inofamba kumamole mashoma egasi (forward) uye NH3 inowedzera.
(B) Kukwidziridza tembiricha kunosarudza endothermic reverse reaction, saka NH3 inoderera.
(C) Pavhoriyamu yakagadzikana, kuwedzera Ar hakuchinji kusimba (partial pressures) kwe N2, H2, NH3, saka Q = K uye hapana chinofamba; NH3 haichinji.
(D) Papressure yakagadzikana, kuwedzera Ar kunowedzera vhoriyamu uye kunodzikisa kusimba kwezvinopindura nezvigadzirwa zvose, saka equilibrium inofamba kudivi rine mamole akawanda egasi (reverse) uye NH3 inoderera.
(E) Kuwedzera $\mathrm{H_2}$ kunoita kuti Q < K, saka forward reaction inoenderera uye huwandu (mol) hwe NH3 hunowedzera.
Nhanho 3: NH3 inowedzera mu (A) ne (E).
Pindura: (A), (E) (b).
